description: This is a Java unit test class for the SecretsAsConfigSupplier class, testing its behavior with different environment setups for secrets directory paths and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: SecretsAsConfigSupplierTest
classes.description: A Java JUnit test class for testing the SecretsAsConfigSupplier class, focusing on secrets directory configuration and secret retrieval behavior.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Static setup method that initializes the path to the secrets directory and loads an initial configuration before any tests run.

methods.name: setSecretsDirPathEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Sets the environment variable for secrets directory path before each test to ensure consistent environment setup.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Ensures that the SecretsAsConfigSupplier class and related configurations are immutable.

methods.name: useDefaultSecretsDirPathIfNotSetByEnvVariable
methods.description: Tests that the default secrets directory path is used when the environment variable is not set.

methods.name: useSecretsDirPathOfSystemEnvironment
methods.description: Verifies that the secrets directory path is retrieved correctly from the environment variable.

methods.name: getEmptyConfigForNotExistingDir
methods.description: Checks that the supplier returns an empty config when the secrets directory does not exist.

methods.name: getEmptyConfigForEmptyDir
methods.description: Verifies that the supplier returns an empty config when the secrets directory exists but is empty.

methods.name: getReturnsExpectedSecretsConfig
methods.description: Validates that the secrets configuration is correctly read and parsed into the expected config object.
